instruction: Produce concise brownfield refactor requirements as Markdown. Include numbered In scope and Out of scope sections, FR-* functional requirements, NFR-* non-functional requirements, a PII inventory table, a role matrix, numbered executable acceptance criteria, and open questions. Preserve the approved no-op rule when the requested extraction already exists.

inputs.content: The user's Lane/LaneHeader request maps to Kaneo's Column/ColumnHeader. Goal: ensure header rendering and behavior are extracted from Column while preserving behavior exactly. In scope: column/index.tsx, column-header.tsx, optional column-header.test.tsx. Preserve layout, accessibility, permissions, modals, archive behavior, store updates, translations, toast, and drag/drop. Retain Column terminology. If Column already only composes ColumnHeader and ColumnHeader owns the header responsibilities, implementation must be a no-op. No API, database, realtime, translation, styling, permission, or broader cleanup changes.
Column currently owns isDropzoneOver state, container classes, a wrapper around <ColumnHeader column={column} />, and <ColumnDropzone> composition.

ColumnHeader currently owns icon/name/task count rendering, permission-gated create/archive controls, modal state, archive mutations, project-store update, translated labels/toast, CreateTaskModal, and ArchiveTasksModal.

acceptance: Requirements mandate no-op if extraction is complete
